enrichment.summary: This amendment extends the agreement with the Strategic Education Research Partnership Institute (SERP), which is helping develop a year-long high school chemistry curriculum, from July 31, 2019 to July 31, 2020. The amendment document itself changes only the term. The district memo cites $80,000 in Koshland Foundation grant funding for the part-time science specialist, and the grant award letter lists $80,000 for the 2019-20 school year, so this appears to be the next year's installment rather than a restatement, though the documents do not say so outright.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.sourceIssue: The official text accepts an $80,000 grant award in an item titled as an extension of time, without saying whether it is new money or the original grant restated; the signed amendment itself changes only the term.
items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Amendment No. 1, SubAward Agreement between the District and Strategic Education Research Partnership Institute (SERP), Washington, DC, for the latter to support development of a year-long high school chemistry curriculum, as described herein, and accepting associated $80,000.00 grant award therefor, from the Koshland Foundation, pursuant to terms and conditions thereof, extending the term of the SubAward Agreement from October 1, 2018 through July 31, 2019 to July 31, 2020.  All other terms and conditions of the SubAward Agreement remain in full force and effect.
items.title: Amendment No. 1, Subaward Agreement - Strategic Education Research Partnership (SERP) Institute - (Extension of Time) - Academics and Instructional Innovation Department

enrichment.headline: Approves a side agreement with the teachers union on release time for a National Education Association grant
enrichment.summary: The district and the Oakland Education Association (OEA), the teachers union, sign a side letter about the National Education Association (NEA) Community Schools Grant. It gives a teacher release time from the classroom to take part in OEA leadership, for July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020. The side letter itself stays in effect through June 30, 2022. The text states no dollar amount.

attachments.name: 19-1681 Professional Services Contract - Board on Track - Charter Schools Office

enrichment.headline: Ratifies up to $45,000 for Board on Track to support charter school board appointments

money.evidence: in an amount not to exceed $45,000.00

enrichment.summary: Board on Track of Concord, Massachusetts helps the Office of Charter Schools with appointments to charter school boards. It builds video training modules for appointees, advises staff on reporting materials and applicant matching, and gives selected boards a skills appraisal in June 2020. The contract runs July 1, 2019 through June 30, 2020 and is capped at $45,000. It began before Board approval.
